content.tex: B MODELLING (QUESTIONS 6 to 10)
ENCLOSURES FOR CATS (30 marks\()\)
You are advised to spend no more than 50 minutes on this part.
Volume, \(V\) , of cylinder of radius \(r\) , height \(h\) . \(V = \pi r^{2} h\)
Volume, \(V\) , of cone of radius \(r\) , height \(h\) . \(V = \frac{1}{3}\pi r^{2} h\)
Volume, \(V\) , of sphere of radius \(r\) . \(V = \frac{4}{3}\pi r^{3}\)
This task looks at modelling the floor area and volume of enclosures for cats.
Dorothy has two cats and is going to build an enclosure for them. She considers three designs.
